item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will determine its goals, limit its access, oversee its actions, and retain the authority to stop it.

2. We reject the claim that superintelligence means losing control. Intelligence is not sovereignty. We will build safeguards, enforce clear limits, and keep ultimate decision-making power in human hands.

3. Superintelligent AI will be a powerful human-made tool—not an independent ruler. If it is built within the next 20 years, we will control how it operates, where it is used, and what it is permitted to do.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 110 words

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will remain fully under human control. We will decide how it is designed, where it is deployed, what systems it can access, and when it must stop. Human institutions will set the rules, enforce safeguards, and retain ultimate authority over every consequential use. Superintelligence will expand our capabilities, not replace our judgment or sovereignty. We reject the idea that greater intelligence automatically means independence from human direction. Through deliberate engineering, rigorous oversight, secure infrastructure, and clear accountability, we will keep this technology serving human purposes. Its power will remain a tool of humanity, governed by people.
